name: mdast
description: Markdown parsed by remark, including GFM strike, tasks, notes and table alignment. Checks the public Markdown importer too.

name: hast
description: HTML parsed by rehype. Checks rich table interchange, including captions, widths, spans, attributed sections and block cells.

name: commonmark.js
description: The JavaScript CommonMark reader and renderer. Unsupported GFM strike is reported explicitly.

name: cmark
description: The native reference reader. XML text nodes preserve whitespace between adjacent inline elements.

name: djot.js
description: Djot parsing, rendering and writing, with repeated and nested notes, definitions, tasks, table captions and alignment. A tested workaround covers hard breaks.

name: Docutils
description: Native doctrees and HTML output. Loose-list layout and heading-level boundaries are recorded.

name: Asciidoctor.js
description: Block AST and converted inline HTML, checked against a separately mapped DocBook tree.

name: MD4C
description: A small C driver captures parser events and native HTML. Unbalanced event streams fail validation.

name: Pandoc
description: Pinned native reader and writer. Rich tables use JSON interchange; note identity, vertical alignment and source-spelling boundaries remain explicit.
